primary_source_receipts.claim: Tricolor and First Brands September 2025 collapses; JPMorgan $170M and Dimon cockroach remark
primary_source_receipts.access_scope: SEARCH_EXCERPT_SECONDARY_COVERAGE; exact filing dates not confirmed
primary_source_receipts.finding: Tricolor bankrupt in September 2025, First Brands Chapter 11 weeks later; $170M JPMorgan charge; Dimon quote on Q3 2025 call (Oct 2025). All before publication.

primary_source_receipts.finding: Merger terminated effective 2025-11-18, announced 2025-11-19, citing market conditions; 80-cent exchange ratio not confirmed.

primary_source_receipts.claim: EO 14330 and DOL 401(k) alternative-asset safe harbor proposal
primary_source_receipts.finding: EO signed 2025-08-07; DOL proposed rule 2026-03-30, comments due 2026-06-01; asset-neutral process-based safe harbor.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Non-traded BDC redemption requests and fulfilment 2026
primary_source_receipts.finding: Q1 2026 requests >$15B with about $7B returned; Q2 2026 about $15.6B requested, $5.9B returned; BCRED Q2 demand about 10% held at 5% cap; Fitch Q3 average request 9.8% (post-publication).

calculation_receipts.method: Analyst arithmetic on narrator figures; proration assumes all holders request 100% and fund buys 5% of shares outstanding per quarter
